build.//: pew2 is not distributed through any store. These profiles build something you install on your own phone.

apk.//: Android, and the reason this project needs no developer account: a signed APK is installed once and does not expire.

device.//: iOS, signed for devices registered to your own Apple ID. A free account signs for 7 days; a paid one for a year. See README.

simulator.//: iOS Simulator build. No signing, no account, no expiry - the quickest way to try a fork.
